report.title: Review coordinates
report.text: Original design mockup, not a manufacturing specification. Units are proof units, not physical millimetres. Sheet x increases right and y down. Panel u increases right and v down on the upright, outside-facing TRIMMED artwork. Review heading is clockwise from panel-right; 0° points right, 90° down. Each panel owns its own marker and note. Switching views changes presentation, not saved review coordinates.

report.title: Placement record — complete rule
report.text: rawSize is the untrimmed artwork width and height. trim gives left, top, right and bottom in that raw frame. Panel width = rawSize.width − trim.left − trim.right; height similarly. First add left/top trim to (u,v). If reflectedX is true, replace raw x by rawSize.width − x (back-printed panel). Then rotate clockwise by rotationClockwise about raw (0,0). Finally add sheetOrigin. sheetOrigin is added after both operations; it is not necessarily the placed artwork’s upper-left. Fold direction is already represented by the rotation; no extra fold transform applies.

report.title: Directions & editing
report.text: For heading, use direction (cos θ, sin θ); negate its x component for reflectedX, then apply the same clockwise rotation. Trim and translation never change direction. In panel view, show the unchanged local heading. Coordinates and heading fields ALWAYS edit panel-local values, including in Flat sheet. Tapping the artwork moves the active marker: invert the placement in Flat sheet; in Individual panel use the trimmed frame directly. Clamp to the trimmed panel rectangle; typing Save review commits coordinates, heading and note together. Reload preserves each proof/panel review independently.

report.title: Geometry on screen
report.text: The imported Source proof is the original flattened drawing. Individual-panel artwork is a separate upright trimmed rendition. Both are fitted without stretching; any letterbox margin is not artwork. Dashed lines are folds, solid outlines are trim edges. Arrow heading and anchor must refer to the same panel through both views. A saved note must not move a marker.
